Hi team,

Quick intro — I wanted to pass along a strong referral, Aisha Khan, who I worked with at CloudWave. She's expressed interest in the Senior SRE role and asked to be prioritized for scheduling if we proceed. High-level: 6+ years infra, distributed systems, on-call ownership, big-system debugging.

I've attached Aisha's resume and a signed permission-to-contact. If we can move quickly, happy to do a quick intro call or handoff. Can someone from recruiting pick this up and propose interview windows today?
